# opstracer_suppression (Resource)

Silences only the alerts of one service that match all the given conditions, for a time window, and counts how many it caught. With no condition it matches every alert of the service. To silence a whole service or integration, use `opstracer_mute`. A suppression cannot be edited, so any change replaces it, except writing the same time in another UTC offset. Once the window is over it stays in state as inactive; one ended early outside Terraform is created again. Destroy ends a running suppression and cancels a scheduled one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Silence only low-severity Datadog alerts from staging, for one day.
resource "opstracer_suppression" "staging_noise" {
  service_id  = opstracer_service.checkout.id
  severities  = ["P4", "P5"]
  source_type = "datadog"
  tags        = { env = "staging" }
  ends_at     = "2026-11-02T09:00:00+07:00"
  reason      = "Noisy staging monitors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) RFC 3339 end of the window. Must be in the future and after `starts_at`.
- `service_id` (String) Service whose alerts are suppressed.

### Optional

- `integration_id` (String) Match alerts from this integration only.
- `reason` (String) Why the alerts are suppressed.
- `routing_hints` (Map of String) Routing hints on the alert that must all match.
- `severities` (Set of String) Match any of P1 ... P5.
- `source_type` (String) Match alerts from this integration type: `alertmanager`, `datadog`, `generic`, `grafana`, `newrelic`, `pagerduty`, `railway`, `sentry`, `supabase`, `vercel`.
- `starts_at` (String) RFC 3339 start of the window, e.g. `2026-10-20T09:00:00+07:00`. Defaults to the time of creation.
- `tags` (Map of String) Alert tags that must all match.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the suppression is in effect right now. False before the start and after the end.
- `id` (String) Suppression ID.
- `match_count` (Number) Number of alerts suppressed so far.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Only scheduled and running suppressions can be imported.
terraform import opstracer_suppression.staging_noise <service-id>/<suppression-id>
```
